_about: Project authorization, provider tier evidence, task capability and dispatch/cost permission are independent. Qualified workers first for every work kind; premium requires documented need plus exact per-slice user permission. Unknown choices remain held.
_legacy: Empty engine/model data is advisory compatibility only. It is not project tier evidence, authorization, a premium assignment or cost permission. No mandatory workKindTiers mapping.
_allowlistSchema: projects[p].allowlist: [{id,confirmedBy,confirmedAt,source}]. Actual user confirmation only; still intersect configured/catalog/readiness gates. Does not assign tier or spend.
_modelDecisionsSchema: projects[p].modelDecisions[key]: {tier,preferenceRank:null|nonnegativeInteger,confirmedBy:'user',confirmedAt,sourceRef,modelFingerprint,catalogFingerprint,retirementGeneration,scope:'model|catalog'}. Actual answer only; classification never authorizes a model. Catalog-scoped ordering binds the resolved catalog/lifecycle hash.
_premiumApprovalsSchema: projects[p].premiumApprovals[slice]: {keys,profileHash,approvedBy:'user',approvedAt,expiresAt,sourceRef}. Requires premiumNeed {requirementIds,reason,cheaperRejected:[{key,reason,evidenceRef}]} and exact current task/key/time matching. No default approval.
_opencodePreferenceSchema: projects[p].opencodePreference: {chosen:[],offered:[],askedAt,confirmedBy:'user',sourceRef,catalogFingerprint,scope:'catalog'}. Exact engine/model keys, local metadata only, resolved catalog binding; no tier/authorization from preference or legacy global preference.
_snapshot: Schema 2 requires canonical hash, valid time/earliest evidence expiry and unchanged config,bots,catalogs,policy,evidence,decisions,history,limits,opencode fingerprints. Stale catalog requires a valid current-session readiness capture; capture is an attestation, not permission.
_evidence: <STATE>/provider-evidence.json holds {schema:1,records:[]}; local sanitized sourceRef or official HTTPS source, exact provider/account identity and validity. Evidence.catalogFingerprint binds raw catalog; decisions/preferences bind resolved hashes/generation. No automatic rebinding or tier inference from names/effort/price. Import via evidence-import; this comment is not an executable policy path setting.
_knownExceptions: [{instanceId,threadPrefix?,model?,reason}] declares platform-internal audit exceptions only, never authorization, tier or dispatch permission.
